description: Ask SVV a bounded public question. Supported intents: capabilities, merchant_policy, merchant_trust and product_search. This tool never orders, negotiates, contacts people, takes payment or changes store data.

in_stock_only.description: For product_search, include only items with positive catalog stock when true. Defaults to true.

intent.description: Select capabilities, merchant_policy, merchant_trust or product_search.

max_price_eur.description: Optional inclusive upper limit in euros for a product’s minimum catalog price.

max_results.description: Maximum number of product matches to return, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

permission_scope.description: Use public_read, the supported permission scope for these queries.

query.description: For product_search, enter at least two characters of a product name, character, brand or franchise. The first 200 characters are used.

request_id.description: Optional client reference echoed in the response, up to 128 characters.

name: agent_query
